issue: The book prints दर्शन इच्छित फल पाते, two mātrās short of the caupāī's 16; the word dropped is not settled: Drik Panchang has दर्शन कर, Aarti Mala (an indif.com printout) दर्शन से, and no independent site could be read.
our reading: दर्शन कर इच्छित फल पाते (having had his darśana, they obtain the fruit they wish for)
alternatives: दर्शन से इच्छित फल पाते (by his darśana they obtain the fruit they wish for)

issue: ‘साईंदास आरती को गावै’: the poet's signature, or any servant of Sāī (साईंदास as a common noun) who sings it.
our reading: Sāīṁdāsa sings the āratī; dwelling at home, he finds happiness and blessing
alternatives: whoever, as Sāī's servant, sings the āratī finds happiness and blessing at home
